v9-7.candidate: David said to him, “Do not fear. For I will certainly show you mercy because of Jonathan your father. I will restore to you all the land of Saul your father’s father, and you will eat bread at my table continually.”

v9-10.candidate: You, your sons, and your servants shall work the land for him. You shall bring loaves to your master’s son, and he will eat them. And Mephibosheth, your master’s son, shall eat bread continually at my table.” Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

v10-3.candidate: The leaders of the sons of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, “Do you think David is glorifying your father by sending comforters to you? But has David not sent his servants to you so that they may search the city, spy it out, and inspect it?”

v10-13.candidate: Joab and his people with him advanced to battle against Syria, and the Syrians fled before him.
